intro.h2: See the finished room first, then decide
paragraphs: Most kitchen remodeling in Wayne, NJ runs through three hires: a designer, a round of bids, then a builder. Hamlett Renovations keeps all of it under one contract. The team laser-measures your room, draws two or more layouts and renders the result in photorealistic 3D, so you can change it on screen before anything is ordered.

The price is then built line by line against the drawings you approved, with allowances named for anything still to be picked. Hamlett even posts its ranges: $35,000 to $60,000 for a refresh that keeps the layout, and $60,000 to $140,000 for a full design-build kitchen.

services.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Wayne, NJ, Plus the Rest of the House

items.name: Bathroom Design & Build

why_choose_us.h2: Why North Jersey homeowners pick Hamlett

items.title: You walk through it before you sign
items.text: Kitchens, baths, basements, additions and decks are rendered to scale. You see the finished room in 3D, and change it, before you sign a construction contract.

items.title: One contract, the company's own crew
items.text: Hamlett self-performs framing, carpentry and finish work, so the people who start your job are the people who finish it. Long-time trade partners handle mechanical, electrical and plumbing.

items.title: A clean house at the end of the day
items.text: Google reviewer Mae A. wrote that the workspace was clean at the end of each day. Daily cleanup, permits and inspections are listed as always included on kitchen and bath jobs.

about.h2: Devin Hamlett runs the job; Shawn Brinster runs the numbers
about.text: Devin Hamlett started Hamlett Renovations in 2019 working in the field, and he still runs the jobs. He draws and renders every project himself, walks you through the options and is on your site daily while it is being built. Co-owner Shawn Brinster handles estimating, scheduling, materials and the money. He builds the number your project is priced against and keeps the job supplied and on schedule. You deal with one of them directly, never a salesperson who hands you off after signing. The family-owned firm holds New Jersey Home Improvement Contractor license #13VH12093400 and carries general liability and workers' compensation.

process.h2: Four steps from first call to final walkthrough

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Devin walks the space, laser-measures it and talks through how you actually use it. There is no charge, and the visit takes 60 to 90 minutes.

steps.title: Design and renderings
steps.text: Measured drawings, layout options, selections and 3D renderings. From $5,000 for kitchens and $2,500 for bathrooms, credited toward construction. Skipped when the layout stays put.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Priced line by line against the approved drawings, then built by Hamlett's own crew with permits pulled, inspections scheduled and one point of contact.

steps.title: Warranty
steps.text: The team hands the space over, walks every drawer and detail with you, and backs the work with a 1-year workmanship warranty.

service_area.h2: Based in Wayne, building across four counties
service_area.text: Hamlett's shop is in Wayne, and its crews work in Bergen, Passaic, Morris and Essex County. Recent jobs include kitchens in Teaneck, Hackensack, Paramus and Montclair, bathrooms in Maywood, Clifton and North Haledon, and decks in Westwood, Glen Rock and Hawthorne. Franklin Lakes is about six miles from the Wayne shop. If your town is not on the list, ask; the team will tell you honestly whether it covers your street.

faq.h2: Kitchen and bath questions we hear in Wayne

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost in Wayne and Bergen County?
items.a: Hamlett publishes its ranges. A refresh that keeps the layout runs $35,000 to $60,000. A full design-build kitchen, with walls or plumbing moving and new cabinetry, runs $60,000 to $140,000. Cabinetry line and door style move the number most, followed by countertop material and slab count.

items.q: How long will my kitchen or bathroom be out of use?
items.a: A kitchen refresh that leaves walls, plumbing and appliance spots alone runs 3 to 6 weeks. A full design-build kitchen runs 10 to 14 weeks, and cabinet lead time is usually the biggest variable, so cabinets are ordered early. Most bathrooms take 2 to 4 weeks.

items.q: Do I have to pay for the first meeting?
items.a: No. The consultation is no charge and takes 60 to 90 minutes in your home. A paid design phase only applies when the layout is changing, and that fee is credited in full toward construction. If you decide not to build, you keep the drawings and renderings.

items.q: Are you licensed and insured in New Jersey?
items.a: Yes. Hamlett holds New Jersey Home Improvement Contractor license #13VH12093400, carries general liability and workers' compensation, and pulls its own permits in the towns it works in. Structural drawings are reviewed and sealed by a licensed New Jersey architect inside Hamlett's contract.

items.q: I already have architect plans. Can you still help?
items.a: Yes. For a plan review, the team renders your existing drawings in 3D, flags what will not build or will blow the budget, and gives you a real construction number against the design you own. The review costs $1,500, credited toward construction.

final_cta.h2: Ready to see your kitchen before it is built?
final_cta.text: Book a design consultation and the team calls back the same business day.
